remarks_1999: Not recorded Abiquiú Notebooks. Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Mrs. Wiener's (formerly Alma Morganthau Wertheim) apartment, March, 1946... .No signature. Nothing written on back. From Miss O'Keeffe to Mrs. Wiener. ... Very good. Note: Miss O'Keeffe thinks painted about 1926." Wiener brought work to An American Place shortly after Irvine had examined it to have it reframed and it was stolen while it was in storage there. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive date 1926. Dated c. 1923 on basis of inclusion in 1924 New York (Anderson) exhibition; pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 24. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Seaweed

description: Green, blue, pink, and red strands of seaweed run vertically over the composition. The work features several different varieties of seaweed with varied textures. A light blue and white background sets off the darker shades of the seaweed.
title: Seaweed
